ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat/ALPHV Rust encryptor launch via distinctive `--access-token` / `--propagated` / `--child` argv flags
ucs.description: Hunts execution of the BlackCat (ALPHV/Noberus) Rust-based ransomware binary, which is one of the only ransomware families that requires an operator-supplied 32-char `--access-token` and exposes a set of flags (`--child`, `--propagated`, `--paths`, `--no-prop`, `--ui`, `--bypass`, `--drag-and-drop-target`) used to control propagation. The combined flag pattern is unique to BlackCat affiliates and is documented in CrowdStrike, Microsoft, and Mandiant reporting on the actor.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd values(Processes.process_path) as image_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name!="" (Processes.process="*--access-token*" OR Processes.process="*--propagated*" OR Processes.process="*--child*" OR Processes.process="*--no-prop*" OR Processes.process="*--drag-and-drop-target*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval token_present=if(match(cmd,"(?i)--access-token\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}"),1,0) | eval flag_count = mvcount(split(cmd,"--"))-1 | where (token_present=1 OR flag_count>=2) AND NOT match(process_name,"(?i)^(devenv|code|chrome|msedge|firefox|node|python|java)\.exe$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// BlackCat/ALPHV encryptor — unique argv flag combination
let BlackCatFlags = dynamic(["--access-token","--propagated","--child","--no-prop","--paths","--no-net","--drag-and-drop-target","--bypass"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where isnotempty(ProcessCommandLine)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (BlackCatFlags)
| extend HasAccessToken = ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--access-token\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}"
| extend FlagHits = countof(tolower(ProcessCommandLine), "--")
| where HasAccessToken == true or (ProcessCommandLine has "--propagated" and ProcessCommandLine has "--child")
     or (ProcessCommandLine has "--access-token" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--paths","--no-prop","--no-net"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("devenv.exe","code.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, IsAdmin = ProcessIntegrityLevel
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// BlackCat/ALPHV encryptor — unique argv flag combination (Sentinel)
let BlackCatFlags = dynamic(["--access-token","--propagated","--child","--no-prop","--paths","--no-net","--drag-and-drop-target","--bypass"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where isnotempty(CommandLine)
| where CommandLine has_any (BlackCatFlags)
| extend HasAccessToken = CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--access-token\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}"
| where HasAccessToken == true
     or (CommandLine has "--propagated" and CommandLine has "--child")
     or (CommandLine has "--access-token" and (CommandLine has "--paths" or CommandLine has "--no-prop" or CommandLine has "--no-net"))
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: BlackCat/ALPHV Ransomware Distinctive Command-Line Flags
id: a6d3b9c4-2e7f-4f0a-9d3a-blackcat-cli-001
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of the BlackCat/ALPHV Rust ransomware binary based on its unique mandatory --access-token flag and propagation flags (--child, --propagated, --no-prop, --paths, --drag-and-drop-target).
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2022/06/13/the-many-lives-of-blackcat-ransomware/
  - https://www.crowdstrike.com/blog/blackcat-ransomware-analysis/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/23
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - threat-actor.blackcat
  - threat-actor.alphv
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_token:
    CommandLine|re|i: '--access-token\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}'
  selection_propagation:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '--propagated'
      - '--child'
  selection_combo:
    CommandLine|contains: '--access-token'
    CommandLine|contains|any:
      - '--paths'
      - '--no-prop'
      - '--no-net'
      - '--drag-and-drop-target'
  filter_dev_tools:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\devenv.exe'
      - '\code.exe'
  condition: (selection_token or selection_propagation or selection_combo) and not filter_dev_tools
falsepositives:
  - Extremely unlikely — these flags are specific to the BlackCat binary
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@CommandLine:(*"--access-token"* AND (*"--paths"* OR *"--no-prop"* OR *"--no-net"* OR *"--drag-and-drop-target"*)) OR @CommandLine:(*"--propagated"* AND *"--child"*)) -@Image:(*\devenv.exe OR *\Devenv.exe OR *\DEVENV.EXE OR *\code.exe OR *\Code.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (regex("--access-token\\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}", field=CommandLine, flags="i") OR (regex("--propagated", field=CommandLine, flags="i") AND regex("--child", field=CommandLine, flags="i")) OR (regex("--access-token", field=CommandLine, flags="i") AND regex("--(paths|no-prop|no-net|drag-and-drop-target)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")))
| NOT ImageFileName=/\\(devenv|code|chrome|msedge|firefox)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp), max(@timestamp), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData])])
ucs.rationale: The BlackCat encryptor is the only documented ransomware family that REQUIRES an operator-supplied --access-token (32-char hex) at runtime as a per-victim license gate, and exposes the --child/--propagated/--no-prop/--paths/--drag-and-drop-target flag set described in CrowdStrike's Noberus reporting and Microsoft's ALPHV/BlackCat analysis. ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat affiliate BYOVD chain: POORTRY/STONESTOP signed kernel driver loaded to neutralize EDR before encryption
ucs.description: Hunts for the Bring-Your-Own-Vulnerable-Driver (BYOVD) tradecraft that BlackCat/ALPHV affiliates (UNC2596 / Storm-0875 / FIN12 overlap) deploy in the hours before ransomware detonation: a STONESTOP user-mode loader writes a Microsoft-signed but malicious kernel driver (POORTRY — `ktgn.sys`, `viragt64.sys`, `RentDrv2.sys`, `mhyprot2.sys`) into System32\drivers, creates a kernel service for it, and loads it to terminate AV/EDR processes. The signed-driver-from-unusual-path + service-create + kernel-load chain is a high-signature BlackCat precursor.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as path values(Filesystem.process_name) as writer values(Filesystem.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="*\\System32\\drivers\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ProgramData\\*") (Filesystem.file_name="ktgn.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="viragt64.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="RentDrv2.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="mhyprot2.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="BadRentdrv2.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="gdrv.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="truesight.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="aswarpot.sys") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | join type=inner dest [| tstats summariesonly=true count as svc_create_count values(Processes.process) as svc_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*sc*create*" OR Processes.process_name="sc.exe") (Processes.process="*type=*kernel*" OR Processes.process="*type= kernel*") by Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`] | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// BlackCat BYOVD: POORTRY-family signed driver written then loaded to kill EDR
let KnownBYOVDDrivers = dynamic(["ktgn.sys","viragt64.sys","rentdrv2.sys","badrentdrv2.sys","mhyprot2.sys","gdrv.sys","truesight.sys","aswarpot.sys","procexp152.sys"]);
let DriverWrites =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where tolower(FileName) in (KnownBYOVDDrivers)
       or (FolderPath has_any (@"\Windows\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\") and FileName endswith ".sys")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("trustedinstaller.exe","msiexec.exe","wuauclt.exe")
    | project DriverWriteTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, DriverName = FileName, DriverPath = FolderPath,
              WriterImage = InitiatingProcessFileName, WriterCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              WriterUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName, WriterSHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256;
let ServiceOrLoad =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where (FileName =~ "sc.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "create" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("kernel","type= kernel","type=kernel"))
         or (FileName =~ "fltmc.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "load")
         or (FileName =~ "sc.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "start" and ProcessCommandLine has_any (KnownBYOVDDrivers))
    | project SvcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, SvcCmd = ProcessCommandLine, SvcUser = AccountName;
DriverWrites
| join kind=inner ServiceOrLoad on DeviceId
| where SvcTime between (DriverWriteTime .. DriverWriteTime + 30m)
| project DriverWriteTime, SvcTime, DeviceName, DriverName, DriverPath, WriterImage, WriterCmd, SvcCmd, WriterUser, WriterSHA256
| order by DriverWriteTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// BlackCat BYOVD: POORTRY-family driver write + kernel service create (Sentinel)
let KnownBYOVDDrivers = dynamic(["ktgn.sys","viragt64.sys","rentdrv2.sys","badrentdrv2.sys","mhyprot2.sys","gdrv.sys","truesight.sys","aswarpot.sys","procexp152.sys"]);
let DriverWrites =
    ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventType =~ "FileCreated"
    | where tolower(TargetFileName) in (KnownBYOVDDrivers)
        or (TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Windows\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\") and TargetFileName endswith ".sys")
    | project DriverWriteTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, DriverName = TargetFileName, DriverPath = TargetFilePath,
              WriterImage = ActingProcessName, WriterCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine, WriterUser = ActorUsername;
let ServiceCreate =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("sc.exe","fltMC.exe")
    | where (CommandLine has "create" and CommandLine has_any ("kernel","type= kernel","type=kernel"))
         or (CommandLine has "start" and CommandLine has_any (KnownBYOVDDrivers))
         or (NewProcessName has "fltMC.exe" and CommandLine has "load")
    | project SvcTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SvcCmd = CommandLine, SvcUser = Account;
DriverWrites
| join kind=inner (ServiceCreate) on $left.DvcHostname == $right.Computer
| where SvcTime between (DriverWriteTime .. DriverWriteTime + 30m)
| project DriverWriteTime, SvcTime, Host = DvcHostname, DriverName, DriverPath, WriterImage, WriterCmd, SvcCmd, WriterUser
| order by DriverWriteTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) ((@EventID:11 AND (@TargetFilename:(*\ktgn.sys OR *\KTGN.SYS OR *\viragt64.sys OR *\VIRAGT64.SYS OR *\RentDrv2.sys OR *\rentdrv2.sys OR *\mhyprot2.sys OR *\MHYPROT2.SYS OR *\gdrv.sys OR *\GDRV.SYS OR *\truesight.sys OR *\TRUESIGHT.SYS OR *\aswarpot.sys OR *\ASWARPOT.SYS) OR (@TargetFilename:(*\Windows\Temp\*.sys OR *\ProgramData\*.sys OR *\Users\Public\*.sys) AND -@Image:(*\TrustedInstaller.exe OR *\trustedinstaller.exe OR *\msiexec.exe OR *\MsiExec.exe)))) OR (@EventID:(1 OR 4688) AND @Image:(*\sc.exe OR *\SC.exe OR *\fltMC.exe OR *\fltmc.exe) AND @CommandLine:((*create* AND (*"type= kernel"* OR *"type=kernel"*)) OR *"load"* OR *ktgn.sys* OR *viragt64.sys* OR *mhyprot2.sys* OR *RentDrv2.sys*)))

(#event_simpleName=FileWritten AND (TargetFileName=/\\(ktgn|viragt64|RentDrv2|BadRentdrv2|mhyprot2|gdrv|truesight|aswarpot|procexp152)\.sys$/i OR (TargetFileName=/\\(Windows\\Temp|ProgramData|Users\\Public)\\[^\\]+\.sys$/i AND NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(TrustedInstaller|msiexec|wuauclt)\.exe$/i)))
